name: insert_id
description: Cloud Logging LogEntry insertId. Also used as the streaming insert row ID.

name: ingest_timestamp
description: Time the ingestion service received the Pub/Sub message.

name: event_type
description: CODEMENDER_SCAN_STARTED, CODEMENDER_SCAN_COMPLETED, CODEMENDER_FINDING, CODEMENDER_PATCH, SANDBOX_RESULT, IAM_POLICY_CHANGE, or OTHER_SECURITY.

name: severity
description: Finding severity for CodeMender events, LogEntry severity otherwise.

name: project_id
description: GCP project that produced the log entry.

name: resource_type
description: Monitored resource type, e.g. cloud_run_job, project.

name: resource_name
description: Affected resource: audit resourceName, sandbox job name, or CodeMender file path.

name: status
description: Event status. For SANDBOX_RESULT this is the verdict.

name: raw_payload
description: Full LogEntry as JSON text, capped at 100 KB (oversized entries are wrapped as {truncated, original_bytes, prefix}).
